text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time after the team's dynamic becomes awkward, a certain incident occurs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Due to a blunder by Rice Shower, Team Zenith challenges our team to an unofficial match. The stakes? The losing team forfeits the right to use the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite Team Zenith offering to hand us victory if we clinch even a single race, none of our members manage to win. Rice Shower was our last hope, but even she loses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although the stakes of the challenge are ultimately nullified, Rice Shower remains dispirited by her defeat and loses all cheer.
